---
title: inif.sequences
description: Sequence (de)duplication implementations powering InifDocument.deduplicate_sequences and .expand_sequences.
reference: inif.sequences
---

Sequence (de)duplication is exposed as methods on
[`InifDocument`](inif.models.qmd) — `deduplicate_sequences(min_length=5)`
and `expand_sequences()`. The implementations live in this module.

See [Sequences and deduplication](../concepts/sequences.qmd) for the
algorithm and tuning guidance.
